Subject: SIG v3 intake — SDLC controls (PR sampling + change exceptions)

Vivek,

Thanks for the quick intake call today. As part of GreenBank's SIG v3 review we need a concise package covering a few SDLC topics so our assessor can validate controls. Specifically we need: 

- PR sampling methodology for the last 12 months (how samples are selected, tooling, reviewer roles)
- Change-exception log (all emergency/expedited changes and approvals for past 12 months)
- CI/CD runner policy and secrets-handling notes (ephemeral runner usage, secret injection patterns)
- Any redacted examples for low-level audit review (PR diffs, approval threads)

Can you confirm what you can share by EOD Thu 16 Sep? If you anticipate redactions, please indicate what will be redacted and why.

Also please include a contact who can answer follow-up technical questions from the assessor.

Best,
Natalie Burns
Senior Assessor — VeriAssess
[Attachment: SIG-v3-checklist.xlsx (XLSX)]

Thanks, we can provide the items you listed. Owners: Irene will own PR sampling artifacts, Marissa will pull the change-exception log and approvals, and Lauren will provide the CI runner and secrets handling notes. I will coordinate and be your primary contact for the assessor.

Proposed deliverables and timeline:
- PR sampling package (methodology doc + CSV of selected PRs): by Thu 16 Sep EOD
- Change-exception log (redacted PDF + approval chain): by Fri 17 Sep noon
- CI runner policy and secrets handling summary (MD + references): by Thu 16 Sep

We expect to redact token values, internal service account identifiers (full GUIDs), and any customer-identifying data. We will keep PR diffs intact and include reviewer timestamps where possible. If your assessor needs unredacted artifacts we will need an NDA addendum and a documented justification.

Irene will share the sample selection criteria in her first message; Marissa will attach the formal exception log. If that timeline is acceptable we will upload to the shared Drive link and paste the HubSpot intake record for traceability.

-Vivek

Hi Natalie —

Attached the initial artifacts for PR sampling and the CI runner policy. Quick notes:

- Attachments included: pr-sample-matrix.csv (sample selection), ci-runner-policy.md (policy text)
- Sampling approach: stratified-random across the main service repos, weighted to changes affecting infra and authentication modules; timeframe: 2026-09-01 to 2027-08-31
- Selection controls: automated label-based tagging + daily reviewer assignment via our internal bot (ReviewBot) to avoid manual bias. Reviewer roles are recorded (author, peer reviewer, security approver).
- Redactions: we removed personal email addresses and replaced service account IDs with a randomized token (e.g., svc-xxxxx). PR diffs remain intact except for token strings and customer data.

Marissa — the change-exception log is in your court; please include the approval thread where possible. Lauren — can you confirm ephemeral-runner retention windows and whether secrets are mounted vs injected?

Irene Choi
Sr. Engineering Manager, Developer Productivity | Redwood Inference
